main.description: Get a specific tip received by the authenticated user (as the recipient/subject). Looks up by tip record uri, sender DID, or record uri. These are mutually exclusive and resolved in that order.

uri.description: AT-URI of the tip record. Takes precedence over sender and recordUri.

sender.description: DID of the tip sender. Takes precedence over recordUri.

recordUri.description: AT-URI of the record being tipped. Ignored if uri or sender is provided.
